tools.name: soap-security_soap-security-policy-audit
tools.description: Compare WS-Policy and WS-SecurityPolicy assertions across caller-supplied WSDL 1.1 bindings and operations. audit_status is valid, warnings, policy_conflicts, invalid, or incomplete. risk_level is low, medium, high, or critical. A declared policy is not evidence that a server enforces it. Imports ar

tools.name: soap-security_policy-strength
tools.description: Score a caller-supplied algorithm suite, body signature, body encryption, timestamp, and token kind. Basic256Sha256 contributes the most, TripleDes and None the least. A username token scores below an X.509 token. The grade follows that score. No certificate is validated and no policy file is fetche
